review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role is perfect for recent graduates or those with 0-2 years of experience eager to build a career in networking. This is a hands-on role designed for individuals who are passionate about networking and ready to apply foundational knowledge in a professional setting. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent practical experience) 0-2 years of experience in network support or administration Foundational understanding of networking concepts: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, subnetting, VLANs Familiarity with routers, switches, and firewalls (Cisco, Juniper, or similar) Basic knowledge of network monitoring tools and remote troubleshooting Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail Excellent written and verbal communication for remote collaboration Ability to work independently and manage time effectively A+ / Network+ / CC
